description: V7 Capacity Lab — machine-readable experiment definitions. LAB-ONLY. NOT a V7 visual contract, protocol spec, or wire-format definition.

prng.status: LAB-ONLY — does NOT select the final V7 protocol PRNG.
prng.zero_seed_rule: seed=0 is rejected. Seed is masked with 0xFFFFFFFF before use.
prng.state_transition_pseudocode:
x = state
x ^= (x << 13) & 0xFFFFFFFF
x ^= (x >> 17) & 0xFFFFFFFF
x ^= (x << 5) & 0xFFFFFFFF
state = x
return x

symbol_generation.method: take upper 16 bits of next 32-bit output, modulo symbol_count

prng.state_continuity_across_data_frames: PRNG state continues across data frames without reset. The state at the end of data frame N is the starting state for data frame N+1.
prng.calibration_prng_note: Calibration frames are solid-color fills — they do NOT consume PRNG state. The PRNG is first used at the start of data frame 0 and continues from there.

2x2.name: 2x2
2x2.semantics: Four equal-quadrant regions. Split at rows//2 and cols//2. Region IDs: 0=TL, 1=TR, 2=BL, 3=BR. For odd grid dimensions, bottom and right regions get the extra row/col (integer division remainder). No lane headers, no lane IDs on wire — purely spatial subdivision.

calibration_solid_frames.frame_contents: Each frame is a solid fill: every cell set to the same symbol index. Frames are generated in palette index order: 0, 1, ..., symbol_count-1.
calibration_solid_frames.frame_index: sequential, starting from 0, incrementing across all frame types

calibration_preamble_frames.frame_contents: Cycles through solid calibration colors: frame i uses symbol index (i % palette.symbol_count). Cycle repeats if preamble_frames > symbol_count.

data_frames.frame_contents: PRNG-filled symbol matrix. Each cell consumes one PRNG symbol. If reference_cell_density > 0, a boolean mask replaces every Nth cell (row-major count, starting at cell 0) with ref_color_index=0.
data_frames.prng_state: PRNG is instantiated with profile.seed at the start of build_frame_sequence. Calibration frames do not advance PRNG state. The first PRNG call generates the first cell (row 0, col 0) of data frame 0. PRNG state continues across data frames without reset.

frame_sequence.frame_index_semantics: Monotonically increasing integer, starting at 0, assigned sequentially across ALL frames (calibration + data) in generation order.
frame_sequence.logical_epoch_semantics: Cumulative logical display epoch counter. Starts at 0. Increments by dwell_epochs per frame. E.g. with dwell_epochs=2: frame 0 at epoch 0, frame 1 at epoch 2, frame 2 at epoch 4, etc.
frame_sequence.canonical_generator_behavior: The Python Capacity Lab build_frame_sequence() produces a FINITE sequence: num_data_frames data frames preceded by optional calibration. It does NOT loop, wrap, or produce infinite streams. Desktop playback looping/wrapping is a presentation-layer concern and NOT part of the canonical lab generator semantics.

solid_frames.frame_contents: every cell filled with the calibration symbol index

preamble.symbol_ordering: Cycle through palette indexes: frame i uses symbol index (i % palette.symbol_count). Cycle repeats if preamble_frames > symbol_count.
preamble.frame_contents: every cell filled with the selected symbol index

reference_cells.density_rule: density=0: disabled (no reference cells). density=N: every Nth cell (row-major count, starting at cell 0) becomes a reference cell.
reference_cells.mask_build_algorithm: Iterate cells row-major. Maintain a zero-based counter. Cell is reference if counter % density == 0.
reference_cells.overlay_timing: Mask is applied to each data frame AFTER PRNG generation and BEFORE hashing. Reference cells do not consume additional PRNG state.

lab_serialization.description: One unsigned byte per symbol index, row-major. Each symbol index (0..symbol_count-1) is stored as a single uint8. NOT V7 wire packing — laboratory representation only.
lab_serialization.ordering_detail: for r in 0..rows-1: for c in 0..cols-1: emit uint8(matrix[r][c])

hash_functions.symbol_crc32: CRC32 (zlib) over lab-serialized bytes, uppercase hex
hash_functions.symbol_sha256: SHA-256 over lab-serialized bytes, lowercase hex

erasure_marker.semantics: Sentinel value (-1) used in received symbol matrices to indicate an unclassifiable cell. Erasures are excluded from BER denominator and numerator; counted separately by erasure_rate(). Erasures count as errors in SER.

sequence_symbol_sha256.description: SHA-256 over lab-serialized bytes of all calibration frames followed by all data frames, concatenated in generation order. Contains 4 calibration + 4 data frames = 12800 total symbols.
